title: Private Romantic Walking Tour in Halifax Historic Waterfront
includes: Entry ticket to Art Gallery of Nova Scotia (USD12 ⁓ EUR11) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Skip the crowds this is a private tour for your group only! Explore Halifax with your significant other! Together with the professional local guide, you will visit the most romantic places in Halifax such as the historic Halifax Citadel. You will stroll around the city’s charming streets while listening to fascinating facts and stories told by your charismatic guide. Where can you take lovely photos with your partner? What is the best place for a date? You will discover the most romantic spots in Halifax! As you walk down Halifax Waterfront, you will be amazed by incredible views of the harbor. This tour is a perfect way to enjoy a few romantic moments in Halifax!
